text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, November 13, 2018 Posted by admin on November 13th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Coca Cola (KO), McDonald’s (MCD), Procter & Gamble (PG) and Verizon (VZ). Dow stock 52 week lows include Goldman Sachs (GS).
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +124 points.
Monday the Dow was down -602.12 (-2.32%) at 25,387.18.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.70%.
There were 4 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Verizon (VZ) +0.44%, Coca Cola (KO) +0.38% and Procter & Gamble (PG) +0.31%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Goldman Sachs (GS) -7.46%, Apple (AAPL) -5.04% and Home Depot (HD) -3.53%.
Dec WTI crude oil prices (CLZ18 -1.94%) this morning are down -$1.22 a barrel (-2.04%) at a 9-month low and Dec gasoline (RBZ18 -1.78%) is -3.12 (-1.91%) at a 13-month low.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down nine-tenths of a cent at $2.686 per gallon.
